newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity names two new Select Fund managers.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity names two new Select Fund managers.

text.p: Fidelity Investments Friday named Bill Rubin to succeed David Ellison as portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Home Finance Portfolio.

Ellison, who managed the $759 million fund since December, 1985 and produced among the best returns in the sector by investing in banks and home lenders, has resigned effective October 1, Fidelity said in a statement.
Rubin was named as Ellison's replacement. He will continue to manager the Select Defense and Aerospace portfolio which he has run since December 1994.

Steven DuFour was also named portfolio manager of the Fidelity Select Energy fund. he will continue to serve as the natural resources sector leader and portfolio manager of Fidelity Select Transportation Portfolio, which he has managed since 1994.

DuFour succeeds Albert Ruback who continues to serve as the cyclicals sector leader and portfolio manager of the recently launched Fidelity Advisor Cyclical Industries Fund, the nation's largest mutual fund firm said in a statement.
